user.title: Set up your aquarium
user.description: Create your aquarium in Reef Control.

data_description.aquarium_name: Name used for this aquarium throughout Reef Control.
data_description.volume: Actual water volume after displacement by rock, sand and equipment.
data_description.tank_type: Classifies the aquarium, for example Mixed Reef, SPS, LPS or soft coral.
data_description.supply_system: Main supplementation system for major and trace elements, for example Balling Light, ATI Essentials, Oceamo, Triton or a calcium reactor.
data_description.reef_method: Berlin: classic skimmer/rock-based reefing. Triton: ICP + refugium. DSR: measurement/dosing-focused with reduced water changes. None/Other: flexible operation.

init.title: Configure Reef Control
init.description: Choose an area to edit. Changes stay in this configuration session until you select Save & close.

entities.title: Equipment & entities
entities.description: Assign one or more Home Assistant entities to each aquarium equipment group. Sensor inputs such as temperature and water level remain configured separately.

data_description.skimmer_entities: Select all entities that switch your protein skimmer equipment on and off.
data_description.return_pump_entities: Select all return pumps. With redundant pumps, Reef Control considers the return system running while at least one selected pump is on.
data_description.flow_pump_entities: Select all circulation / wavemaker pump entities, for example both left and right flow pumps.
data_description.uvc_entities: Select all entities that switch UV-C equipment on and off.
data_description.light_entities: Select all entities used to control the aquarium lighting.
data_description.heater_entities: Select all heater entities. Automatic temperature control switches the selected heaters as one group.
data_description.ato_entities: Select all entities belonging to the automatic top-off pump group. Automatic water-level control switches the selected pumps as one group.
data_description.calcium_reactor_entities: Optional: select switchable calcium-reactor equipment. Multiple entities are allowed, for example feed pump, circulation pump or CO₂ valve. Reef Control treats them as one equipment group for feeding/maintenance pauses.
data_description.leak_entities: Select one or more binary sensors/input booleans that detect water or a leak. A leak is considered detected when any selected sensor is active.

water_values.title: Water values
water_values.description: Assign the sensors Reef Control should monitor.

data_description.temperature_entity: Primary sensor providing the current aquarium water temperature.
data_description.ph_entity: Primary sensor providing the current pH value.
data_description.salinity_entity: Primary sensor providing the current salinity.
data_description.water_level_entity: Digital float/optical sensor or numeric water-level sensor. Numeric values can be evaluated as water level in cm.
data_description.conductivity_entity: Electrical conductivity sensor. Reef Control normalizes µS/cm and mS/cm and can calculate salinity from conductivity and temperature.
data_description.redox_entity: Sensor providing oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) in mV.
data_description.salinity_source: Auto uses a direct salinity sensor when configured, otherwise conductivity + temperature. You can also force either source.

limits.title: Monitoring limits
limits.description: Choose the water parameter whose monitoring limits you want to configure.

temperature_limits.title: Temperature limits
temperature_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical safety limits for temperature.

data_description.temperature_min: Below this value the temperature is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.temperature_max: Above this value the temperature is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.temperature_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates the temperature as critical.
data_description.temperature_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates the temperature as critical.

ph_limits.title: pH limits
ph_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical limits for pH.

data_description.ph_min: Below this value the pH is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.ph_max: Above this value the pH is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.ph_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates the pH as critical.
data_description.ph_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates the pH as critical.

salinity_limits.title: Salinity limits
salinity_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical limits for salinity.

data_description.salinity_min: Below this value salinity is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.salinity_max: Above this value salinity is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.salinity_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates salinity as critical.
data_description.salinity_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates salinity as critical.

redox_limits.title: Redox limits
redox_limits.description: Define the normal range and critical limits for oxidation-reduction potential.

data_description.redox_min: Below this value ORP is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.redox_max: Above this value ORP is outside the desired normal range.
data_description.redox_critical_min: Below this value Reef Control rates ORP as critical.
data_description.redox_critical_max: Above this value Reef Control rates ORP as critical.

operating_modes.title: Operating modes
operating_modes.description: Configure how Reef Control controls equipment during feeding and maintenance.

data_description.feeding_duration: How long feeding mode remains active before it ends automatically.
data_description.skimmer_delay: Additional delay before all previously running protein skimmers restart after feeding mode ends.
data_description.feeding_pause_skimmer: Switch all assigned protein skimmers off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_return_pump: Switch all assigned return pumps off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_flow_pump: Switch all assigned flow pumps off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_uvc: Switch all assigned UV-C devices off while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_ato: Pause the assigned automatic top-off pump group while feeding mode is active.
data_description.feeding_pause_calcium_reactor: Switch all assigned calcium-reactor entities off while feeding mode is active. Disabled by default.
data_description.maintenance_pause_skimmer: Switch all assigned protein skimmers off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_return_pump: Switch all assigned return pumps off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_flow_pump: Switch all assigned flow pumps off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_uvc: Switch all assigned UV-C devices off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_ato: Pause the assigned automatic top-off pump group while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_heater: Switch all assigned heaters off while maintenance mode is active. Automatic temperature control is paused during maintenance.
data_description.maintenance_pause_light: Switch all assigned aquarium lights off while maintenance mode is active.
data_description.maintenance_pause_calcium_reactor: Switch all assigned calcium-reactor entities off while maintenance mode is active. Disabled by default.

temperature_control.title: Temperature control
temperature_control.description: Configure automatic heater control. A temperature sensor and at least one heater must be assigned under Equipment & entities / Water values.

data_description.temperature_control_enabled: Enables Reef Control's automatic heater control.
data_description.temperature_target: Temperature Reef Control should maintain. All selected heaters switch off when this temperature is reached.
data_description.temperature_hysteresis: Prevents frequent switching. Example: with 25.0 °C target and 0.3 °C hysteresis, heating starts at 24.7 °C or below and stops at 25.0 °C or above.
data_description.temperature_min_on_time: After switching on, the heater group must remain on for at least this long before Reef Control may switch it off.
data_description.temperature_min_off_time: After switching off, Reef Control waits at least this long before the heater group may be switched on again.

reef_icp.title: Reef ICP
reef_icp.description: Link this Reef Control aquarium to a Reef ICP aquarium. The latest ICP data will then be included in Reef Control.

data_description.reef_icp_entry: Select the Reef ICP aquarium whose analysis data belongs to this Reef Control aquarium. Choose no link to disconnect it.

reef_icp_unavailable.title: Reef ICP
reef_icp_unavailable.description: No Reef ICP aquarium was found. Install and configure Reef ICP first.

ato_control.title: Water level control
ato_control.description: Configure automatic top-off. A water-level sensor and at least one ATO pump must be assigned first.

data.ato_low_state: State meaning water level is low

data_description.ato_control_enabled: Enables automatic top-off control by Reef Control.
data_description.ato_low_state: Choose whether ON or OFF from your sensor means that the water level is too low.
data_description.ato_confirm_delay: The water level must remain low for this long before the pump group starts. This filters waves and brief sensor changes.
data_description.ato_max_runtime: Hard safety limit for one top-off cycle. When exceeded, all selected ATO pumps are switched off and the controller locks until you turn water level control off and on again.
data_description.ato_cooldown: Minimum waiting time after a completed top-off before another top-off may start.
data_description.water_level_mode: Auto lets Reef Control distinguish digital sensors from numeric cm values. You can override the type if needed.
data_description.water_level_low_cm: For a numeric water level, this value or lower is considered low.
data_description.water_level_high_cm: For a numeric water level, this value or higher is considered high.

equipment_control.title: Equipment control
equipment_control.description: Link return pumps, protein skimmers, UV-C, ATO and optionally flow pumps logically. If the complete return system stops, Reef Control can safely pause dependent equipment and restart it in a controlled sequence.

data.return_master_skimmer: Make skimmer(s) depend on return system
data.return_master_uvc: Make UV-C depend on return system
data.return_master_ato: Make ATO depend on return system
data.return_master_flow: Make flow pump(s) depend on return system

data_description.equipment_control_enabled: Enables cross-device safety and restart logic.
data_description.return_master_skimmer: Stops all selected protein skimmers whenever no selected return pump is running and restarts previously running skimmers after the configured delay.
data_description.return_master_uvc: Stops all selected UV-C devices when return flow is unavailable and restarts them after the configured delay.
data_description.return_master_ato: Blocks the ATO pump group while no return pump is running. Automatic water-level control is re-evaluated after restart.
data_description.equipment_skimmer_delay: Delay after the return system starts before controller-paused skimmers are restarted.
data_description.equipment_uvc_delay: Delay after the return system starts before controller-paused UV-C devices are restarted.
data_description.return_master_flow: Optional: Stops all selected flow pumps with the return system and restarts them in a controlled way. Disabled by default because display-tank circulation often should keep running.
data_description.equipment_flow_delay: Delay after the return system starts before controller-paused flow pumps restart.

safety_control.title: Safety control
safety_control.description: Central aquarium protection. Safety rules take priority over normal timers and control logic. A detected leak remains latched until safety control is deliberately switched off and on again.

data.safety_heater_high_temp: Immediately switch heater(s) off at critical high temperature
data.safety_heater_sensor_fail: Switch heater(s) off if temperature sensor fails
data.safety_leak_return_pump: Switch return pump(s) off on leak
data.safety_leak_ato: Switch auto top-off off on leak

data_description.safety_control_enabled: Enables Reef Control central safety interlocks.
data_description.safety_heater_high_temp: If temperature reaches the configured critical maximum, all assigned heaters are switched off immediately without waiting for minimum run time.
data_description.safety_heater_sensor_fail: Fail-safe: if the configured temperature sensor is unavailable or invalid, all assigned heaters are switched off.
data_description.leak_active_state: Choose whether ON or OFF from your sensor means that a leak has been detected.
data_description.safety_leak_shutdown: Enables the latched leak safety stop. After a leak, Reef Control does not automatically restart equipment it switched off.
data_description.safety_leak_return_pump: Switches all assigned return pumps off during a leak safety stop.
data_description.safety_leak_skimmer: Switches all assigned protein skimmers off during a leak safety stop.
data_description.safety_leak_uvc: Switches all assigned UV-C devices off during a leak safety stop.
data_description.safety_leak_ato: Immediately switches all assigned auto top-off pumps off and keeps them off during a leak safety stop.
data_description.safety_leak_heater: Switches all assigned heaters off during a leak safety stop.

uvc_control.title: UV-C control
uvc_control.description: Control all assigned UV-C devices automatically. Reef Control respects the schedule, return system and feeding/maintenance modes.

data_description.uvc_control_enabled: Enables automatic UV-C control by Reef Control.
data_description.uvc_mode: Continuous keeps all assigned UV-C devices on, Schedule runs them only in the selected window, and Off keeps them switched off.
data_description.uvc_start_time: Time at which UV-C should start in schedule mode.
data_description.uvc_end_time: Time at which UV-C should stop in schedule mode. Overnight schedules are supported.

aquarium_profile.title: Aquarium & system
aquarium_profile.description: Edit the existing aquarium profile. This does not create a new aquarium and does not change the internal config-entry ID.

data_description.aquarium_name: Visible name used by Reef Control. Renaming does not create a new aquarium.
data_description.volume: Actual water volume after displacement by rock, sand and equipment.
data_description.tank_type: Classifies the aquarium, for example Mixed Reef, SPS, LPS or soft coral.
data_description.supply_system: Main supplementation system. Balling Light, ATI Essentials, Oceamo and Triton can unlock dosing-related module suggestions; Calcium Reactor unlocks the reactor module.
data_description.reef_method: Berlin: classic skimmer/rock-based reefing. Triton: ICP- and refugium-focused system. DSR: measurement- and dosing-focused system with reduced water changes. None/Other keeps the setup flexible.

system_modules.title: Suggested modules
system_modules.description: Reef Control uses the selected reef method and supply system to offer relevant optional modules. Nothing is enabled automatically.

system_modules_none.title: Suggested modules
system_modules_none.description: No additional module is currently suggested for this profile. Change the reef method or supply system under Aquarium & system to get matching suggestions.

refugium_module.title: Refugium module
refugium_module.description: Assign refugium equipment and store the intended lighting window. In v0.12.2 these settings prepare the module and dashboard; Reef Control does not yet switch the refugium automatically.

data_description.refugium_module_enabled: Marks the refugium module as configured/used for this aquarium. It does not start automatic control yet.
data_description.refugium_light_entities: One or more Home Assistant entities used for refugium lighting.
data_description.refugium_pump_entities: Optional pumps dedicated to the refugium.
data_description.refugium_light_start: Stored target start time for a future automatic refugium-light controller.
data_description.refugium_light_end: Stored target end time for a future automatic refugium-light controller. Overnight windows are supported by the stored profile.

dosing_module.title: Dosing & trace elements
dosing_module.description: Assign dosing-related entities for the selected supply system. v0.12.2 stores and exposes the configuration only; Reef Control does not automatically calculate or execute doses yet.

data_description.dosing_module_enabled: Marks dosing as part of this aquarium setup and exposes it in the system profile.
data_description.dosing_pump_entities: Entities for the main supplementation system, for example Balling Light, ATI Essentials, Oceamo or Triton dosing channels.
data_description.trace_dosing_entities: Optional entities used for trace-element or single-element dosing.

calcium_reactor_module.title: Calcium reactor
calcium_reactor_module.description: Prepare a calcium-reactor setup with its components, reactor pH sensor and CO₂ valve. Automatic pH/CO₂ regulation is intentionally not active yet in v0.12.2.

data_description.calcium_reactor_module_enabled: Marks the calcium-reactor module as configured for this aquarium.
data_description.calcium_reactor_entities: Switchable reactor components such as circulation or feed pumps. The selected CO₂ valve is automatically included in this equipment group.
data_description.calcium_reactor_ph_entity: pH sensor inside the reactor. This is reserved for a future fail-safe CO₂ controller.
data_description.calcium_reactor_co2_entity: Switch or input boolean used for the CO₂ solenoid. v0.12.2 does not automatically switch it from pH yet.

error.invalid_limits: Check the limits: critical minimum ≤ normal minimum < normal maximum ≤ critical maximum.
error.invalid_volume: Net water volume must be at least 1 litre.
